bio: Under the neon-lit cobbles of Shadespire lie a labyrinth of tombs. A vast hive of ossuaries and necropolises, all kept in check by one dutiful cryptkeeper – Skoloss. It's this immortal wight's unending duty to make sure the dead in these catacombs stay dead. Skoloss's Barony is the sole one the New Blood let stand – as he is the only thing stopping the entire Evernight Basin being overrun by Undead.
